about: Provenance for every raster shipped with Community Builders of Pecan Grove. Disclosed on the game page: art made with Google's Playground AI tool and checked by the author.
source: Google AI Studio Playground (Build) project export, project-files.zip, downloaded 2026-10-09 by the site owner. The export was opened read-only; no export code was run.
processing: Each image was re-encoded to WebP for the web. Nothing was added or painted over. The export's music file was not shipped.
generator: AI image generation inside the owner's Playground session (Google).
human_review: Ali Keyvanfar, Ph.D. (author check before publication)
people_depicted: None real. Neighbors are invented characters for a made-up town.
